notes.title: Evolutis: Duality at Day of the Devs 10th anniversary!
notes.content:
We're very excited to announce that [i]Evolutis: Duality[/i] is part of the next edition of Day of the Devs, which is celebrating it's 10 year anniversary this weekend!
Double Fine and iam8bit bring you a selection of amazing indie games for a digital AND in-person event, happening at The Midway in San Francisco, CA, on November 5th, and everyone can join us for free! So if you are around, don't miss out this event. If you are not, you can still catch it live online starting today.

Anyway, we're pumped to have [i]Evolutis: Duality[/i] among all these great games and be invited to such an important event for indie games. 

RSVP [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://www.dayofthedevs.com/]here[/url] if you want to attend and we'll see you there!
